about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: A partner to turn a need into reality
about.description: 3DMAKES combines design, 3D technologies and a focus on the result. We work with companies, professionals and private clients to take an idea from the first conversation to the part, the prototype or final production.
about.heroSubtitle: A partner to turn a need into reality
about.humanFace: Every project starts with listening. If the part exists, we optimise it. If it does not exist yet, we design it.
about.storyParagraph1: 3DMAKES was born in 2022 from the intuition of Marco Pagani, 20 years old with a strong passion for computer science, particularly for 3D printing. Starting from a small room with two 3D printers, the company has grown to become an established reality in the additive manufacturing sector.
about.storyParagraph2: Our mission has always been clear: to make 3D printing technology accessible to everyone, from large companies to small artisans, from designers to private technology enthusiasts.
about.storyParagraph3: Today, with a team of qualified professionals and a cutting-edge machine fleet, we offer a complete service of 3D printing, scanning, design and consulting, always keeping the values of quality, innovation and customer attention at the center.
about.valuesDescription: Concrete expertise. Direct dialogue. Tailored solutions.
about.sustainabilityDescription: We are committed to reducing the environmental impact of our production processes. We use eco-sustainable materials where possible and optimize our productions to minimize waste.
about.teamDescription: A team of passionate and highly qualified professionals ready to transform your ideas into concrete reality.

values.reliableDescription: Quality and care in every detail.
values.flexibleDescription: From a single part to series production.
values.closeDescription: A lab in Switzerland, direct contact.
values.innovationDescription: We constantly research the most innovative solutions to offer our customers cutting-edge results. We invest in latest generation technologies and continuously update our skills.
values.qualityDescription: Quality is at the center of everything we do. We use only selected materials and rigorous production processes to ensure that every piece we produce meets the highest quality standards.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.subtitle: Making 3D printing technology accessible to everyone and promoting its adoption in every sector.
mission.description: Our mission is to make 3D printing technology accessible to everyone, offering high-quality services at competitive prices.
mission.revolutionTitle: Revolutionizing the production world with 3D printing
mission.paragraph1: At 3DMAKES, we believe that 3D printing represents a technological revolution destined to radically transform the way we conceive, design and produce the objects that surround us.
mission.paragraph2: Our mission is to lead this revolution, making 3D printing technology accessible and understandable to as many people as possible: from professionals to companies, from students to simple enthusiasts.
mission.commitmentDescription: Ci impegniamo ogni giorno per diffondere la conoscenza e l'utilizzo della stampa 3D attraverso diverse iniziative e approcci.
mission.visionTitle: Un futuro dove la stampa 3D è parte della vita quotidiana
mission.visionParagraph1: Immaginiamo un futuro in cui la stampa 3D non sarà più una tecnologia di nicchia, ma una parte integrante dei processi produttivi di ogni azienda e della vita quotidiana di ognuno di noi.
mission.visionParagraph2: Un mondo in cui gli oggetti vengono prodotti su richiesta, riducendo sprechi e impatto ambientale, dove la personalizzazione è la norma e non l'eccezione, dove le distanze geografiche non rappresentano più un ostacolo alla produzione.
mission.visionParagraph3: Questa è la visione che ci guida ogni giorno e che ci spinge a innovare costantemente, a esplorare nuove possibilità e a condividere la nostra conoscenza con il mondo.
mission.learnWithUs: Impara con noi la tecnologia del futuro
mission.eventsDescription: Organizziamo regolarmente eventi formativi e workshop pratici per avvicinare sempre più persone al mondo della stampa 3D.
mission.introWorkshopDesc: Un workshop pratico di 3 ore per scoprire i fondamenti della stampa 3D, dalla modellazione alla stampa finale.
mission.advancedCourseDesc: Un corso completo di 5 lezioni per approfondire le tecniche di modellazione 3D con software professionali.
mission.masterclassDesc: Una masterclass intensiva di 2 giorni per professionisti che vogliono padroneggiare tecniche avanzate.

calculator.subtitle: Ottieni un preventivo istantaneo per il tuo progetto

calculator.howItWorks: Il nostro calcolatore utilizza un algoritmo che considera vari fattori come le dimensioni dell'oggetto, il materiale scelto, la qualità di stampa e la quantità per fornire una stima rapida del costo.
calculator.accuracy: Il preventivo generato è una stima indicativa che può variare del ±15% rispetto al costo finale. La precisione dipende dalla complessità dell'oggetto, dalle caratteristiche specifiche e da eventuali post-elaborazioni richieste.
calculator.fileFormats: Accettiamo i formati file più comuni per la stampa 3D, tra cui STL, OBJ, STEP e 3MF. Se hai un formato diverso, contattaci per verificare se possiamo elaborarlo o per ricevere supporto sulla conversione.
calculator.deliveryTimes: I tempi di consegna variano in base alla complessità dell'oggetto, al materiale scelto e alla quantità. Per stampe standard, i tempi medi sono di 3-5 giorni lavorativi, mentre per progetti più complessi possono essere necessari 7-10 giorni.
calculator.modelModification: Sì, offriamo servizi di ottimizzazione e modifica dei file 3D. Se il tuo modello necessita di correzioni, spessori minimi, supporti o altre modifiche per garantire una stampa di successo, possiamo intervenire per ottimizzarlo.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions about 3D printing, quotes and delivery
faq.pageSubtitle: Everything you need to know about 3D printing, scanning, quotes and delivery — clear answers from the 3DMAKES lab.
faq.stillHaveQuestionsText: Write to us or calculate a quote: we will help you choose the right technology for your project.
faq.howItWorksAnswer: Upload a 3D file (STL or similar), choose technology, material and quality: the system estimates volume, time and indicative cost. The final quote is always confirmed by our team.
faq.accuracy: How accurate is the generated quote?
faq.accuracyAnswer: The calculator provides a reliable estimate based on volume and print settings. Supports, post-processing or special finishes can change the final price — we confirm everything before production.
faq.fileFormats: What file formats do you accept for 3D printing?
faq.fileFormatsAnswer: We mainly accept STL, OBJ and STEP. If you have another format (3MF, IGES, SolidWorks, etc.), contact us: we can often convert or optimise it for printing.
faq.deliveryTimes: How long does a 3D printing order take?
faq.modelModification: Can you modify my 3D model before printing?
faq.modelModificationAnswer: Yes. We can optimise wall thickness, tolerances, orientation and supports, or apply small model changes on request before production starts.
faq.fdmMaterials: What materials do you offer for 3D printing?
faq.fdmMaterialsAnswer: We offer a wide range including PLA, PETG, ABS, TPU, Nylon and carbon-fibre reinforced filaments. For high-detail work we also offer resin printing (SLA/PolyJet), powder technologies (SLS, MJF) and SLM for metal.
faq.deliveryTimesAnswer: Lead times depend on size, technology, complexity and quantity. Standard orders often complete in 2–5 business days; urgent jobs or short series may need dedicated scheduling.
faq.maxSize: What is the maximum print size?
faq.maxSizeAnswer: With FDM we reach up to 800×800×1000 mm (80×80×100 cm) in a single piece. Larger objects can be printed in sections and assembled.
faq.scanningPrecision: How precise is your 3D scanning service?
faq.scanningPrecisionAnswer: Our professional scanners reach precision up to about 0.1 mm depending on object size and complexity. We can capture geometry and, where useful, texture information.
faq.largeObjectsAnswer: Yes: we can scan large objects up to about 2×2×2 metres, merging multiple scans into one coherent 3D model.
faq.scanOutput: What do I receive after a 3D scan?
faq.scanOutputAnswer: You receive a digital model ready for CAD, reverse engineering or 3D printing (typically STL/OBJ meshes or, on request, files prepared for design work).
faq.priceCalculationAnswer: Price considers material volume, machine time, technology, quality and any post-processing. Use the online calculator for an instant estimate, or contact us for a custom quote.
faq.bulkDiscountsAnswer: Yes: typically about −10% from 5+ parts and about −15% from 10+ parts, with conditions assessed case by case for short series.
faq.qualityControl: What quality control measures do you use?
faq.qualityControlAnswer: Every part goes through dimensional checks and visual inspection. For critical applications we can provide trial prints and documented process parameters.
faq.designAssistanceAnswer: Yes. We help optimise designs for 3D printing, choose materials and technologies, and provide technical advice throughout the project.
faq.whichTechnology: How do I choose the right technology?
faq.whichTechnologyAnswer: We guide you based on budget, strength, precision, aesthetics and quantity. For example FDM for cost-effective functional parts, SLA for fine detail, SLS/MJF for series and complex geometries, SLM for metal.
faq.postProcessing: Do you also offer finishing and post-processing?
faq.postProcessingAnswer: Yes: support removal, sandblasting, sanding, painting and other finishes depending on technology and material. We include them in the quote when needed.
faq.pickupShipping: Can I pick up on site or do you ship?
faq.pickupShippingAnswer: Yes. You can pick up in Figino (Lugano) or receive shipping across Ticino, Switzerland and northern Italy. We coordinate pickup and delivery based on project urgency.
faq.urgentOrdersAnswer: When production capacity allows, we activate accelerated priority. Mention the deadline in the quote request or contact form: we confirm realistic timing within a few business hours.
faq.confidentiality: Are my files and projects confidential?
faq.confidentialityAnswer: Yes. We use files only for quoting and production. On request we can formalise confidentiality agreements (NDA) for business or sensitive projects.
